scope: SplineBuilder control-point removal with complete weights, invalid indices and incomplete-weight refusal; standalone spline save failure/retry.
validation: Before the fix, removing a control retained the removed control weight and made the vector incomplete.

Nine focused spline tests pass with each codec build: negative and positive control indices, out-of-range including INT_MIN, fit/knot removals, rejection without mutation for incomplete weights, and generated ASCII/Binary save/reopen after caller knot update.

For invalid standalone weights, both codec builds refuse output while preserving an existing destination; replacing the invalid spline in the same document permits successful save and fresh readback. File::exportFile creates a new writer per call, so this is same-document rather than same-adapter retry.
Thirty-eight focused geometry tests and six bundled/ten shared HATCH/MPOLYGON controls pass.
limitations: Callers must still update the knot vector after changing control-point count; the builder does not infer a new spline shape.
Headless macOS ARM64 only; native GUI, hosted CI, and other platforms remain open. Current shared-codec build uses scratch CMake glue.
